title: LeoTabs — Tab & Bookmark Organizer for Chrome and Edge
description: Save tabs and bookmarks into project collections. Switch projects, search saved links, and reopen your work with LeoTabs, a free Chrome and Edge extension.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Local Storage & Optional Services | LeoTabs
privacy.description: Read how LeoTabs stores your tab collections, handles optional AI and Notion connections, and protects your browsing data without ads or telemetry.

permissions.title: Chrome Extension Permissions Explained | LeoTabs
permissions.description: Understand why LeoTabs needs tab and storage access, when it requests optional bookmark or history permissions, and how to revoke service access.

support.title: LeoTabs Support — Help with Tabs, Collections & Backups
support.description: Get help with LeoTabs for Chrome and Edge. Find troubleshooting guides, report a bug, or contact the developer about collections, backups and integrations.

changelog.title: LeoTabs Changelog — Features, Fixes & Release Notes
changelog.description: See what's changed in LeoTabs, including tab management improvements, collection features, fixes and links to published extension releases.

uninstalled.title: After Uninstalling LeoTabs — Data & Feedback
uninstalled.description: Learn what happens to your local collections after uninstalling LeoTabs, find backup information, and optionally share feedback with the developer.

docs.title: LeoTabs Guides — Save, Organize & Restore Browser Tabs
docs.description: Learn to save and reopen tabs, organize bookmarks by project, use keyboard shortcuts, import collections, and export saved links to Notion with LeoTabs.

docs/ai.title: Group Tabs with AI — Provider Setup & Privacy | LeoTabs
docs/ai.description: Connect your own AI provider to group browser tabs by topic and organize saved collections. Learn setup, costs, data handling and troubleshooting in LeoTabs.

docs/getting-started.title: Install LeoTabs in Chrome or Edge & Save Your First Tabs
docs/getting-started.description: Install LeoTabs from the Chrome Web Store, open the library, and save your first tab collection. Start organizing browsing projects without an account.

docs/groups-selection.title: Group, Sort & Remove Duplicate Tabs | LeoTabs Guide
docs/groups-selection.description: Organize browser tabs and saved links with groups, sorting and drag and drop. Learn multi-selection and how to close duplicate tabs safely in LeoTabs.

docs/import-export.title: Import Bookmarks & Export Tabs as HTML, JSON or Markdown
docs/import-export.description: Back up LeoTabs collections, import browser bookmarks, and export saved tabs as JSON, bookmark HTML or Markdown. Move your library between Chrome and Edge.

docs/library.title: Organize Tabs & Bookmarks by Project | LeoTabs Guide
docs/library.description: Organize research and work into LeoTabs spaces and collections. Group saved links, add project notes, reorder bookmarks, and switch between browsing tasks.

docs/migrate-tabs.title: Import OneTab, Toby & Browser Bookmarks into LeoTabs
docs/migrate-tabs.description: Move saved tabs from OneTab text, supported Toby JSON or browser bookmarks into LeoTabs. Preview imports, check transferred links, and keep a backup.

docs/notion.title: Export Chrome Tabs & Bookmarks to Notion | LeoTabs
docs/notion.description: Save browser tabs as LeoTabs collections and export their links, groups and notes to Notion. Follow the connection setup and create your first snapshot page.

docs/permissions.title: LeoTabs Permissions Guide — Required & Optional Access
docs/permissions.description: Learn which browser permissions LeoTabs uses for tabs, bookmarks, history and optional integrations, with explanations and controls for revoking access.

docs/recovery.title: Restore Tabs & Collection Versions with LeoTabs Recovery
docs/recovery.description: Recover supported changes with Undo, reopen recently closed pages, and restore saved collections through LeoTabs Timeline and version history.

docs/saving-switching.title: Save & Reopen Chrome Tabs — Switch Projects with LeoTabs
docs/saving-switching.description: Save open Chrome or Edge tabs into a collection, close them when ready, and reopen a project later. Learn how Open, Switch and Auto-update work in LeoTabs.

docs/search-shortcuts.title: Search Tabs & Bookmarks with Keyboard Shortcuts | LeoTabs
docs/search-shortcuts.description: Find open tabs and saved bookmarks with LeoTabs search and its visual switcher. Learn Alt+Q, search scopes, collection filters and customizable shortcuts.

docs/settings-privacy.title: LeoTabs Settings — Themes, Previews & Privacy Controls
docs/settings-privacy.description: Configure LeoTabs appearance, tab previews, automatic updates and optional connections. Manage browser permissions, stored credentials and local data.

docs/troubleshooting.title: Fix LeoTabs Shortcuts, Imports & Collection Problems
docs/troubleshooting.description: Troubleshoot LeoTabs keyboard shortcuts, saved tabs, imports, previews and integrations. Find safe recovery steps and details to include in a support request.
